verdict.rationale: Ultrametric says it runs no model, so it does not generate insights itself. Instead, the user's own agent pulls Ultrametric's process guides, cited research and saved company context to produce suggestions, such as comparing options or running the ai-native-assessment adapter on local project context. The insights therefore come through an external agent, not inside the product. Missing for 10: insights generated inside the product, documented analysis of the user's stored data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the suggestions.
